step1_analysis.circuit_type: Dual-output NMOS current mirror / bias stage
step1_analysis.description: Two identical NMOS transistors sharing gate and source connections, acting as a dual-output current sink or bias distribution circuit.

paper_reference.title: Secure Contactless Smartcard ASIC with DPA Protection

dc_output_current.description: DC current sunk by each drain at a given bias.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using square law model for SKY130 NMOS at Vgs=0.9V.

output_resistance.description: Small-signal output resistance at the drain.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using channel length modulation parameter lambda=0.1/V.

current_matching.description: Ratio of the two output currents.

sky130_expected.reasoning: In schematic simulation without mismatch models, identical devices will have exactly matching currents.

power_consumption.description: Total power consumed by the circuit.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the calculated DC currents at Vbias=0.9V and VDD=1.8V. The paper reports 2.5mW for the entire transceiver, so this sub-block should consume a fraction of that.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC output current, current matching, output resistance, and power consumption of the dual-output current mirror.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Dual Output Current Mirror Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

XM1 N3 N2 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 N2 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

V_N1 N1 0 0
V_N2 N2 0 0.9
V_N3 N3 0 1.8
V_N0 N0 0 1.8

.control
op
let id1 = -i(V_N3)
let id2 = -i(V_N0)
let current_matching = id1 / id2
let total_power = 1.8 * (id1 + id2)
print id1 id2 current_matching total_power

dc V_N3 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc id_09 find i(V_N3) at=0.9
meas dc id_10 find i(V_N3) at=1.0
* i(V_N3) is negative, so id_09 - id_10 yields a positive delta I
let rout = 0.1 / (id_09 - id_10)
print rout
quit
.endc
